Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp`** (src/num.js) — returns n limited to [min, max] using early returns
2. **`formatBytes`** (src/util.js) — formats bytes as B/KB/MB/GB with one decimal place (integers for bytes)
3. **`slugify`** (src/text.js) — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, strips non-word characters except dashes

All are exported and follow the project's code style.
